rather than converting policy design into outcome claims."],"systemic_problems":["The candidate index is not fully exploited; several directly relevant social-policy, childcare, equality receive less complete treatment."],"concrete_corrections_required":["Add the omitted full-index evidence identified for each question, particularly child-benefit take-up, Bürgergeld risks, welfare, housing, food, permits, and jobs were used as political loyalty instruments.","For 6B.10, separate refugee-specific life chances from general-population outcomes and incorporate both favorable employment/GDP context and adverse purchasing-power and poverty evidence."],"safe_for_judge_use":true,"rationale":"The answers are factually well supported by the cited passages and highly
